frontmatter.title: Qualify fresh opener withdrawal at an outdated native location

sections.content:
## Context

The human explicitly included this narrow two-point prerequisite in the current
character milestone through question call_d8c6b1f77776480da59c8d108d3c43ec:
“Include the narrow extension (Recommended)”. The preceding completed canonical
withdrawal repair deliberately excluded outdated locations. The current owning
PR-flow law still rejects that flag even when the actual finding opener freshly
withdraws an old finding on the exact current head and a later authorized User
settles it. This initial Markdown is supported incoming input, not a native
creation event, reviewed estimate, Ready or operational adoption.

Foresight PR37 original P1 root4278230590/threadPRRT_kwDOU4VJMM6sl4qm motivates
this correction. Historical44-head withdrawal4279274789 and writer4279292162
remain historical; no old disposition transfers to the final head.

## Outcome

A known outdated native location can qualify only within the existing bounded
current-head opener-withdrawal and strictly later authorized User Handled path.
The original finding, severity, review and immutable commit remain inspectable.
Unknown or discordant flags, unresolved conversations and invalid custody refuse.

## Scope

Owning riatzukiza/.agents pure withdrawal predicate, registered regression
coverage and corresponding canonical skill/contract wording only. This primary
Foresight card is the board artifact; the owning source PR carries an attributed
planning snapshot, not a competing board. Estimate2 is provisional until
independent planning review. Keep both concordant known boolean outdated pairs
(false,false)/(true,true), while retaining explicit resolved=true in both
representations and every existing native custody guard.

The prepared original patch remains unapplied; SHA256
c2ec84cbb2e1c29d112c24e0141c41e86d610964d13242f075917c13a3ef4ab1.
Its compatibility check is not RED/GREEN. Two existing fixture matrices need
intentional treatment of the old blanket-outdated negative during qualification.

## Non-goals

Collector/acquisition/pagination/adapter/resolver/identity-list changes, general
outdated-thread settlement, local classifiers, synthetic native evidence,
approval/cohort/check/quota waivers, rewriting receipts or original findings,
credentials, paid model, runtime, deployment, social effects, heartbeat resumption
or a changed B1/B2/B3 finish condition. An insufficient pure boundary requires a
separately included owning prerequisite before expanding scope.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Independent canonical planning review establishes scope, two-point estimate,
   full negative matrix and actual prerequisites. Before Ready, use qualified
   Rheos to reconcile the parent inventory, relevant child identities, estimates
   and current total. Current native parent readback is Incoming epic39; do not
   infer a revised total by blind addition or mix additive execution packets
   with containing history. Preserve every prior point/event/comment and read
   back the independently reviewed inventory/total before lawful readiness.
2. After planning qualification and all lawful Rheos execution hops, causal RED
   shows otherwise qualified current custody with concordant native outdated=true
   refuses solely because of that condition. Keep concordantfalse control and
   label all prospective fixture successors separately from original raw bytes.
3. GREEN admits concordant known true or false only within the existing bounded
   predicate. Missing/nil/nonboolean/mismatched location flags, either unresolved
   flag, stale current withdrawal/writer head, wrong original/root/thread/repo/PR,
   wrong opener/User authority, partial pagination, unknown chronology, late
   edits/retraction/pushback all remain blocked. Exercise the true pair against
   the negative matrix, retaining existing false-pair coverage.
4. Preserve the original root/P1/review/immutable commit and all existing
   substantive rationale, evidence URL, native identity, complete ordered
   conversation, writer authorization and chronology checks. Disposition creates
   no rejection agreement, approval, coverage, review round or required-check
   credit. Ordinary outdated findings without qualified withdrawal stay findings.
5. Full owning law/policy/CLI/portable/lint gates pass with zero warnings; exact
   current head/full changed input review and required hosted checks qualify in
   personal head AND base repositories. Use the already authorized protected
   history-preserving MERGE and verify its actual source/tree/parents.
6. Only after qualified protected adoption, obtain a NEW genuine finding-opener
   recheck/withdrawal and strictly later authorized User Handled at final unchanged
   PR37 head, bound to the actual original root/thread and fresh conversation.
   Read back resolved state and run fresh canonical gate; old44 evidence remains
   provenance, not current settlement. No merge before all remaining gates pass.

## Verification

Read back the primary using the qualified owning Rheos CLI and record actual
source/configuration/artifact identity plus output. No local board parser or
manual transition. Source planning review/readiness precedes implementation.
Run actual causal RED then GREEN, all registered canonical suites and lint,
current native full-input review, protected MERGE/adoption, then the distinct
fresh operational PR37 disposition. Retain exact ledger prefixes and all errors.

## Risks

Confusing location age with authority; mismatched normalized/native flags;
stale writer/opener chronology; silently weakening other outdated findings;
changing only one of two fixture matrices; conflating source approval with real
adoption/settlement; assuming parent arithmetic or source links establish Ready.
